# sfizz messaging ABI

Unmodified public `sfizz_message.h` and license from sfizz 1.2.3 source at commit
`f5c6e29f23b8057867c08e88f5f6ac6738baa30b` (https://github.com/sfztools/sfizz).
The host binds the existing sfizz DLL dynamically. The header describes OSC
argument/callback types; it does not replace the synthesizer.
